name: AstroBin
tagline: Astrophotography image database with platesolving metadata for amateur astronomy apps
description: AstroBin is a public API for searching and retrieving astrophotography images, deep-sky object data, and plate-solving metadata. It is widely used by amateur astronomy developers to power image galleries, object lookups, and equipment/acquisition metadata integrations.

auth.details: API key and API secret via HTTP Basic Auth (username = API key, password = API secret); create keys in account settings after signup

use_cases: search astrophotography images by deep-sky object
fetch plate-solving metadata for an image
list public images by user or equipment
retrieve acquisition and processing metadata for an image
